metadata.route_mix: 45% static; 25% REST ID; 15% dynamic action; 5% nested; 5% constrained; 5% glob

profile_descriptions.mixed: 45% static; 25% REST ID; 15% dynamic action; 5% nested; 5% constrained; 5% glob
profile_descriptions.static: literal-only paths with no captured parameters
profile_descriptions.rest_integer: REST resource routes ending in an unconstrained decimal-looking :id
profile_descriptions.rest_uuid: REST resource routes ending in an unconstrained 36-byte UUID :id
profile_descriptions.rest_ulid: REST resource routes ending in an unconstrained 26-byte ULID :id
profile_descriptions.rest_slug: REST resource routes ending in an unconstrained human-readable slug :id
profile_descriptions.dynamic_uuid: unconstrained UUID :id followed by a literal action segment
profile_descriptions.nested_uuid: two unconstrained UUID parameters in one path
profile_descriptions.constrained_integer: decimal :id checked by an anchored regular expression
profile_descriptions.constrained_uuid: UUID :id checked by an anchored regular expression
profile_descriptions.constrained_ulid: ULID :id checked by an anchored regular expression
profile_descriptions.notfound: paths that do not match any registered route

metadata.legacy_scope: method/path concatenation, split matcher, parameter materialization
metadata.optimized_scope: method-root selection, byte-span matcher, parameter materialization
